budget_ms.definition: max of neighbour-bin spread, ego-class spread, ego-speed slope component (G5, static only)

rule.primary: rejected in camera c if 95% CI of delta_H,c lies entirely outside [-(5 + B_c), +(5 + B_c)] ms
rule.ruled_out: rejected in >= 2 cameras in both the primary run and the margin-flag-excluded run (margin < 0.2 dropped)

slopes: descriptive; predicted half-widths 44/85 (pre-registered) and 32/46 (A3) ms per unit xi for L2R/R2L
descriptive: best single convention = argmin_H sum_c |delta_H,c| / B_c

predicted_outcome.pose: not ruled out (possibly rejected in SIDE_LEFT only)
